<think>The user asks: "أنتج مصفوفة JSON بها 5 إدخالات لكتب خيالية. كل إدخال يحتوي على الحقول: title (string)، author (string)، year (int 1800-2024)، genres (array من 1-3 strings)، rating (float 1.0-5.0)."

We need to produce a JSON array with 5 entries for fictional books. Each entry must have fields: title (string), author (string), year (int between 1800 and 2024), genres (array of 1-3 strings), rating (float 1.0-5.0). The user wants the output in Arabic. The system says "تخرج JSON صالحا فقط — بدون نص نثري وبدون كتل markdown." So we must output only valid JSON, no extra text, no markdown fences.

Thus we need to output something like:

[
  {
    "title": "...",
    "author": "...",
    "year": ...,
    "genres": ["...", "..."],
    "rating": ...
  },
  ...
]

Make sure the JSON is valid. The user is Arabic; we can use Arabic titles and authors. The year must be integer between 1800 and 2024. The rating must be float between 1.0 and 5.0. The genres array must have 1 to 3 strings.

We need to ensure the JSON is valid: proper quoting, no trailing commas, proper array.

We need to output only JSON. No extra text. No markdown fences.

[
  {
    "title": "مغامرة في أرض السحر",
